resolution_notes: pricing.free_tier: original stands (true). Official docs treat Test mode as a free sandbox (no real money; separate rzp_test_ keys) — https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/dashboard/test-live-modes/ — while Live is pay-as-you-go with ₹0 setup and ₹0 AMC and a per-successful-transaction platform fee (e.g. 2% + GST domestic), not a subscription API plan — https://razorpay.com/pricing/ . That model is free-to-start / usage-priced, not “must buy a paid plan,” so free_tier=true with the existing free_tier_limits text (test free; live transaction-priced) matches current official pricing. Auditor is right that test mode is not free production volume, but that is already stated in free_tier_limits and does not require flipping free_tier to false.
